templates.description: Vote count update from a voting place
Attendance update from a voting place

templates.name: Reg
templates.description: Queries the sender's registration, registers a controller with a place id, or registers a mobile team member by adding MTM.

templates.name: Unr
templates.description: Unregisters the sender from their current voting place.

templates.name: Izl
templates.description: Queries or updates turnout for the sender's voting place. Use 'Izl:' to query, 'Izl: N' or 'Izl: N.' for turnout, 'Izl: .M' for home turnout, or 'Izl: N.M' for both.

templates.name: Sta
templates.description: Sets the senderStatus for the sender's voting place.

templates.name: Rez
templates.description: Queries current results with 'Rez:', or updates candidateVotes and ballot totals. Use numeric candidate id.M, N.M for nonRegularBallots, or P.M for remainingBallots. N and P accept Latin or Serbian Cyrillic, in either case.

templates.name: Dok
templates.description: Sends the turnout worksheet with 'Izl', the preliminary results worksheet with 'Pre', or both with 'Izl Pre'. With no parameter, sends both worksheets.
templates.example: Dok: Izl (or Dok: Pre; Dok: or Dok: Izl Pre sends both)

templates.name: Nep
templates.description: Reports an irregularity with optional numeric urgency, violation, and severity parameters, a short explanation, and an attached photo. Use 0 for an unset category.

templates.name: Zap
templates.description: Stores a photo of the polling-station voting record after the sender enters Zap status.
